answer: The glacier schedule is applied in sparrow and lantern shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2022 identities would post 2692 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
